title: Portsmouth Harbor Cruises

services.name: Harbor Cruise
services.desc: As a relaxing end to a busy day or to begin a night on the town, come aboard the Heritage for a jaunt around the Harbor. Relax with your favorite cocktail or local beer from our full service bar and enjoy the nighttime sights of the Seacoast. Immerse yourself in the beauty of a sunset, or view the spectacular lights of the city. Bring a friend and get away from the crowds. Join us! Lightly narrated. services.name: Book A Charter
services.desc: Looking to host a memorable event? Consider a private boat ride aboard the M/V Heritage or the M/V Utopia! The M/V Heritage has a passenger capacity of 49 people while the M/V Utopia accommodates up to 28 guests! Whether you're planning an intimate gathering or a larger function, we’re here to make your event both unforgettable and easy to organize. A charter aboard the M/V Heritage is perfect for a wide variety of occasions, including family reunions, company outings, field trips, cocktail parties, wine tastings, weddings, rehearsal dinners, and surprise birthday celebrations.
